title: Hermeus
description: Hangar greys and one amber: four flat grey bands a step apart (white, near-white, light and mid grey), warm near-black text, pale grey hairlines and quiet text, and a single amber for the display word, hotspots and every hover. One Helvetica-style grotesk throughout, square corners, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a graphite sibling with the same amber
Arimo stands in for TeX Gyre Heros (a Helvetica clone): Arimo shares Helvetica's advance widths, so lines wrap alike
bands: background is white, card the near-white footer/card grey, muted the light product band, secondary the mid grey hero and mission band
secondary-foreground and card-foreground are pure black (nav and button labels); foreground is the warmer near-black body text
the gutter is fluid, 20px at 390 to 75px at 1440 (a 1290px column)
name: hermeus-theme
